name: salvor-example-langchain
description: A support desk built with LangChain's createAgent, made durable by the salvor middleware.

comments.install: run.sh installs with `npm install --omit=optional`: --omit=optional keeps the key-free path from pulling a provider it will not use.
comments.@langchain/anthropic: Optional, and only for the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY path. `npm install` (without --omit=optional) fetches it.
